brief:
Israeli directors Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor will debut their documentary "NAZA" at the Venice Film Festival on Thursday, according to Al-Monitor. The film examines Israel's killing of civilians in Gaza and promises to deliver fresh revelations about civilian deaths in the territory. Both Abraham and Szor are Academy Award winners.

The documentary's premiere arrives as international attention remains focused on civilian casualties in the Gaza conflict. The film represents a notable contribution from Israeli filmmakers to the documentary record of the war, with its explicit focus on Israeli responsibility for civilian deaths during military operations in Gaza.
dek: A new documentary from two Oscar-winning Israeli filmmakers that promises to shed light on Israel's killing of civilians in Gaza is set to premiere at the Venice Film Festival on Thursday. "NAZA" by Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor promises fresh revelations…
title: Israeli filmmakers premiere Gaza documentary at Venice Festival
